ops.title: P6 accepted residuals (pty child-exit liveness) — fable synthesis over 4 review rounds
ops.body:
P6 (cc-orchestrate: `cco.agent.childExited` socket-only op; pty-host reports child exit as an immediate, authoritative death signal driving same-sid respawn) went through 4 adversarial rounds. Closed along the way: report-path socket unlink ordering; kill-driven socket race (per-incarnation socket paths — 64-bit SHA-256 suffix of the spawn nonce, shared helper for wrapper + prober); torn terminal+nonce persist (single-statement `setAgentIncarnation`); delayed/duplicate-report idempotency (per-incarnation `agents.spawn_nonce`, minted per spawn/respawn, carried as `--spawn-nonce`, matched under agentLock; empty nonce never matches — makes the legacy-migration window safe); handleSpawn's post-insert steps under agentLock (fast-exit report serializes behind the spawn continuation); capture re-reads under the lock.

**Accepted residuals (documented, not bugs to fix):**
1. *Pre-insert report loss* — a child that dies after `b.Spawn` but before `insertAgent` fires a report that can't resolve; the wrapper discards it and the row lands active-but-dead, recovered by the unweakened membership/prober/staleness fallbacks (the pre-P6 latency, ~2min). The report is an eager trigger over fail-safe fallbacks by design; wrapper-side retry for this microsecond window would be defensive machinery.
2. *Capture-vs-kill window* — read-only capture can briefly succeed against a just-exited row during a kill cascade (status checked pre-lock; the under-lock re-read doesn't revalidate status). Benign; pre-existing shape.
3. *sun_path boundary* — `<HOME>/.cc-orchestrate/pty/<uuid>-<16hex>.sock` needs len(HOME)+79 ≤ 103; a macOS username >17 chars overflows and fails loud on bind (EINVAL). Pre-existing boundary, 8 bytes tighter with the 64-bit suffix.

Manual-respawn unification through respawnUnderBudget was evaluated and declined (four semantic differences; flags-not-simplification). `-race` is locally unrunnable in this environment (libghostty cgo needs pkg-config); CI's cgo job covers it — watch that job on the ship.
